candidate.title: The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed
candidate.text: The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed. Users of WireGuard transparent encryption are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.

evidence.excerpt:
* The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`)
  has been removed. Users of WireGuard transparent encryption are required to use a Linux kernel with
  WireGuard support.
